name: Pass the Trash
description: Pass the Trash is a stud poker variant in which each player receives seven cards, posts antes, and after a betting round passes three unwanted cards to the next active player to the left. After a second betting round players discard two cards, order the remaining five face down, then reveal them one at a time with betting between each reveal. The highest five-card hand at showdown wins the pot.

setup.players: 2 to 7 players. Best with 4. No partnerships.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck. One deck. No jokers.
setup.dealing: After antes are placed, seven cards are dealt face down to each player. Dealing is clockwise.
setup.equipment: Standard 52-card deck, poker chips for antes and betting.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest five-card poker hand at showdown after the pass, discard, and reveal phases.
rules.gameplay: 1. Antes: All players post the ante. 2. Deal: Seven cards face down to each player. 3. First betting round: Player to dealer's left acts first. 4. Pass the trash: Each active player places three unwanted cards face down; when all are ready, each set of three is passed to the next active player to the left. 5. Second betting round. 6. Discard: Everyone discards two unwanted cards (each keeps five). 7. Arrange: Each player chooses an order for the five cards and stacks them face down. 8. Reveal and bet: Each player turns over the first card of their stack; betting round begun by the player with the highest hand showing. Repeat for second, third, and fourth cards (four cards face up, one face down). 9. Final betting round. 10. Showdown: Highest five-card hand wins the pot.
keyRules: Seven cards dealt to each player; after passing and discarding, best five-card hand wins.
Three cards passed to the next active player to the left after the first betting round.
After receiving passed cards, each player discards two cards before ordering the remaining five.
Reveal is one card at a time with a betting round after each; first reveal betting is led by highest hand showing.
Standard poker hand ranking; high hand wins unless playing a high-low variation.

strategy.basic: Pass your three worst cards in the first pass; avoid keeping unconnected high cards. Discard the two that least help your five-card hand.
strategy.intermediate: Track which cards you passed and to whom; infer what neighbours might have. Order your five cards to reveal strong cards early to lead betting when you have the high hand showing.
strategy.advanced: Bluff by passing strong cards to mislead the left neighbour; balance between improving your hand and hiding strength. In high-low variants, decide declaration based on passed and received cards.
tips: Position to dealer's left acts first in the first betting round; use it to apply pressure.
When revealing, leading with a pair or high card can win the betting round or build the pot when you have the best hand.

variations.name: High-Low
variations.description: Before showdown everyone declares high, low, or both (e.g. chips in fist); high and low winners split the pot.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: High-low only adds declaration; engine overrides can be added when implementing this variant.

variations.name: Three-phase pass
variations.description: First phase: three cards passed left. Second: two cards passed two places left. Third: one card passed three places left. Betting round after each phase.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes pass phases and counts; overrides to be added when implementing.

variations.name: Pot split with next right
variations.description: Pot is split between the high hand and the next active player to the right (the one who received your passed cards).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant changes pot split rules; engine overrides to be added when implementing.
